paragraphs: Philip Morris International Inc. (PMI) is a American publicly traded tobacco company, with products sold in over 180 countries. Marlboro is PMI’s most recognized brand, but in the last quarter of 2023, Iqos generated the greatest revenue. Philip Morris International is often referred to as one of the companies comprising Big Tobacco. The company ranked No. 117 in the 2025 Fortune 500 list of the largest US corporations by total revenue.

The company originated in 1847 in London, but Philip Morris International itself was established in 1987 as an operating company of Philip Morris Companies Inc. In 2003, Philip Morris Companies changed its name to Altria Group. In March 2008, PMI was spun off from Altria and has been an entirely separate entity since then. Philip Morris USA, a subsidiary of PMI's former parent, keeps ownership of the Philip Morris brands for the US market.
The company's legal seat is in Stamford, Connecticut. PMI's operational headquarters are in Lausanne, Switzerland.

With tobacco being addictive and a leading cause of preventable death globally, the company has faced litigation and regulatory measures from governments and has been the subject of scrutiny by the World Health Organization. The company knowingly maintained the claim that smoking cigarettes is harmless, despite overwhelming external and internal evidence that smoking is addictive and dangerous. In response, the company has diversified in the 21st century into smoke-free products such as the Iqos brand of heated tobacco products, Zyn brand of nicotine pouches, and Veev brand of electronic cigarettes.

people.name: Jacek Olczak
people.title: Group CEO PMI
people.bio: Mr. Olczak previously served as Chief Executive Officer from May 2021, Chief Operating Officer from January 2018 to May 2021, and Chief Financial Officer from August 2012 through December 2017. He joined PMI's Polish affiliate in 1993 after working for BDO.
people.quote: Mr. Olczak was appointed as Group CEO PMI, effective January 1, 2026

people.name: Emmanuel Babeau
people.title: Group Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Mr. Babeau previously served as PMI's Chief Financial Officer from May 2020. Before joining PMI, he was Deputy Chief Executive Officer of Schneider Electric, responsible for Finance and Legal Affairs.
people.quote: Mr. Babeau was appointed as Group Chief Financial Officer, effective January 1, 2026

people.name: Frederic de Wilde
people.title: CEO PMI International
people.bio: Mr. de Wilde previously served as President, South and Southeast Asia, Commonwealth of Independent States, Middle East and Africa Regions from January 2023, and President, European Union Region from July 2015 to January 2023. He joined PMI in 1992 as Brand Manager L&M at Philip Morris Belgium.
people.quote: Mr. de Wilde was appointed as CEO PMI International, effective January 1, 2026

people.name: Reginaldo Dobrowolski
people.title: Group Controller
people.bio: Mr. Dobrowolski previously served as Vice President and Controller from August 2021. He served as Vice President, Corporate Financial Planning, Data & Reporting from May 2019 to August 2021 and Director Corporate Financial Planning & Reporting from October 2014 to May 2019.
people.quote: Mr. Dobrowolski was appointed as Group Controller, effective January 1, 2026

people.name: Yann Gu rin
people.title: Group Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Mr. Gu rin previously served as Senior Vice President and General Counsel from July 2023 and held various legal leadership roles across PMI's businesses, regions and functions. He joined PMI in 2006 after working as an attorney at Skadden Arps.
people.quote: Mr. Gu rin was appointed as Group Chief Legal Officer, effective January 1, 2026

people.name: Stacey Kennedy
people.title: CEO PMI U.S.
people.bio: Ms. Kennedy previously served as President, Americas Region & CEO of PMI's U.S. Business from January 2023 and President, South and Southeast Asia Region from January 2018 to January 2023. She began her career with Philip Morris USA in 1995 as a Territory Sales Manager.
people.quote: Ms. Kennedy was appointed as CEO PMI U.S., effective January 1, 2026
